name: rungic-flatpak-codec
description:
Hardware video codecs for Flatpak apps
This project's GStreamer elements (rungich264/h265/vp9dec, rungich264/h265enc) built against the
Freedesktop 25.08 runtime as the GStreamer extension org.freedesktop.Platform.GStreamer.rungic,
which the Freedesktop and GNOME runtimes load (docs/108). They decode and encode on Qualcomm's
msm_vidc V4L2 devices where an app may open them (--device=all); elsewhere GStreamer keeps its
software codecs.
